purpose: Development evaluation only; exclude these headwords and pages from orthographic rule seed training. Assistant-reviewed, not human-verified.
review_method: Read citation context and Emerson page fragments without future model rankings. Identify a form using both historical spelling and the Portuguese sense or quoted example. Do not force uncertain locations.

status_definitions.clear: Assistant identifies a particular Emerson source paragraph and literal form corresponding to this citation occurrence.
status_definitions.ambiguous: Assistant identifies possible locations but cannot establish a unique correspondence; do not count these as confirmed positive labels.
status_definitions.not_found: Assistant did not identify a correspondence on the cited page; not proof that the VLB or dictionary lacks the lexeme.

limitations: No human or specialist verification is claimed.
Source IDs and source_line values identify Emerson transcription paragraphs, not physical printed scan lines.
Character offsets are zero-based, half-open Unicode code-point offsets in the pinned Emerson text snapshot.
Citation-page boundaries are existing estimated boundaries; a not_found case may reflect a citation or boundary error.
The sample deliberately balances baseline difficulty strata; its raw accuracy is not a corpus-wide prevalence estimate.
A clear paragraph match does not validate every dictionary gloss, etymology, or morphological analysis.
